      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "((12.25 * (input1 + input9 + input17 + input25 + input33 + input41 + input49 + input57)) + (6.25 * (input2 + input10 + input18 + input26 + input34 + input42 + input50 + input58)) + (2.25 * (input3 + input11 + input19 + input27 + input35 + input43 + input51 + input59)) + (0.25 * (input4 + input12 + input20 + input28 + input36 + input44 + input52 + input60)) + (0.25 * (input5 + input13 + input21 + input29 + input37 + input45 + input53 + input61)) + (2.25 * (input6 + input14 + input22 + input30 + input38 + input46 + input54 + input62)) + (6.25 * (input7 + input15 + input23 + input31 + input39 + input47 + input55 + input63)) + (12.25 * (input8 + input16 + input24 + input32 + input40 + input48 + input56 + input64))) / (12.25 * (input1 + input2 + input3 + input4 + input5 + input6 + input7 + input8 + input9 + input10 + input11 + input12 + input13 + input14 + input15 + input16 + input17 + input18 + input19 + input20 + input21 + input22 + input23 + input24 + input25 + input26 + input27 + input28 + input29 + input30 + input31 + input32 + input33 + input34 + input35 + input36 + input37 + input38 + input39 + input40 + input41 + input42 + input43 + input44 + input45 + input46 + input47 + input48 + input49 + input50 + input51 + input52 + input53 + input54 + input55 + input56 + input57 + input58 + input59 + input60 + input61 + input62 + input63 + input64) + 1.0)"

        1.0

      "expected_model_benefit": "Adds a continuous height cue, improving separation of compact glyphs from tall glyphs.",

      "uses_only_row_values": true,

      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "(input1 + input2 + input3 + input4 + input5 + input6 + input7 + input8 + input57 + input58 + input59 + input60 + input61 + input62 + input63 + input64 + input9 + input17 + input25 + input33 + input41 + input49 + input16 + input24 + input32 + input40 + input48 + input56) / (input1 + input2 + input3 + input4 + input5 + input6 + input7 + input8 + input9 + input10 + input11 + input12 + input13 + input14 + input15 + input16 + input17 + input18 + input19 + input20 + input21 + input22 + input23 + input24 + input25 + input26 + input27 + input28 + input29 + input30 + input31 + input32 + input33 + input34 + input35 + input36 + input37 + input38 + input39 + input40 + input41 + input42 + input43 + input44 + input45 + input46 + input47 + input48 + input49 + input50 + input51 + input52 + input53 + input54 + input55 + input56 + input57 + input58 + input59 + input60 + input61 + input62 + input63 + input64 + 1.0)"

      "uses_only_row_values": true,

    },
    {

      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,

      "expected_model_benefit": "Highlights closed or nearly closed central structure while remaining a smooth bounded score for margin learning.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,

    {

      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    },
    {
      "name": "semantic_angularity_score",
      "type": "judgment",
      "description": "Rater-estimated degree of sharp, straight, or corner-like strokes in the rendered 8x8 glyph; 0 means mostly rounded and 1 means strongly angular.",
      "value_range": [
